newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee closes steady in kerb, seen firm.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee closes steady in kerb, seen firm.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed steady at 41.50 to the dollar on Saturday after the U.S. currency weakened in international markets and dealers said the rupee would remain firm in the near term.
"The dollar has weakened against most major currencies," one dealer said. "The rupee will remain firm due to a shortage of funds in the domestic market and the dollar's weakness abroad."

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, fixed on June 28, was 40.4600/40.6623 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates ended at 2.60 percent, from 2.65 on Friday. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
